content.value_statement: Quality teams need controlled documentation that supports audits and regulatory submissions. This skill helps structure document control, change workflows, DMS planning, and compliance review.
actual_capabilities: Designs document control structures for classification, numbering, status, approvals, distribution, and retention.
Reviews regulatory documentation alignment with EU MDR, FDA submissions, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971.
Guides change control workflows from request intake through implementation verification and closure.
Outlines DMS requirements for storage, workflow, validation, training, and performance monitoring.
Supports electronic signature and electronic record control planning for 21 CFR Part 11.
Defines documentation quality metrics, audit checks, and continuous improvement actions.
limitations: Does not provide legal or regulatory approval; qualified personnel must make final decisions.
Included reference and script files are placeholders, not functional automation tools.
Requires user-provided procedures, records, and jurisdictional requirements for detailed review.
Does not connect to or validate a live document management system.

use_cases.title: Build a Document Control System
use_cases.description: Create a structure for document types, numbering, approvals, distribution, retention, and obsolete document handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare Regulatory Documentation
use_cases.description: Review submission documents for completeness, traceability, formatting, and alignment with selected market requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan an Electronic DMS Rollout
use_cases.description: Define DMS requirements, validation needs, training plans, and performance metrics before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Procedure
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one document control procedure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this document control procedure for ISO 13485 readiness. Identify missing roles, approval steps, retention controls, and audit evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Change Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate design of a controlled document change process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a document change control workflow for our quality system. Include intake, impact assessment, approval, training, implementation, and closure.

prompt_templates.title: Assess DMS Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for an electronic document management system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our readiness for an electronic DMS rollout. Cover requirements, validation, access control, electronic signatures, migration, training, and metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Map Global Documentation Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a documentation control plan for EU MDR, FDA, and ISO 13485 needs. Include ownership, traceability, language control, and submission readiness.

output_examples.input: Review our approval process for ISO 13485 document control readiness.
output: Findings grouped by approval roles, version control, distribution, retention, and audit trail evidence.
A prioritized gap list with suggested procedure updates and required records.
Questions for quality owners before final approval.

output_examples.input: Plan a DMS rollout with electronic signatures.
output: A readiness checklist for requirements, validation, access controls, training, and migration.
A 21 CFR Part 11 planning section for electronic records and signatures.
Metrics for rollout progress, user adoption, and system performance.

output_examples.input: Create documentation metrics for management review.
output: A KPI set covering accuracy, compliance, cycle time, user satisfaction, and system performance.
Recommended evidence sources for each metric.
Improvement actions tied to weak or missing documentation controls.

best_practices: Provide current procedures, document types, and approval roles before asking for a review.
Ask for jurisdiction-specific checks when regulatory expectations differ by market.
Confirm recommendations with quality, regulatory, and legal owners before implementation.
anti_patterns: Asking it to approve a controlled document without qualified human review.
Treating placeholder scripts or references as production automation.
Requesting generic compliance answers without product, process, or market context.

faq.question: What kind of documentation does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports medical device quality system documents, regulatory documents, change records, DMS planning records, and audit evidence.

faq.question: Can it approve controlled documents?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare review guidance, but authorized quality or regulatory personnel must approve controlled documents.

faq.question: Does it include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The included script and reference files are placeholders, so users must provide or build real automation.

faq.question: Which standards does it mention?
faq.answer: It references ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR, FDA submission documentation, and 21 CFR Part 11 planning topics.

faq.question: Can it help with DMS implementation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline requirements, validation planning, access controls, training, migration, and performance monitoring.

faq.question: What input improves the results?
faq.answer: Provide procedures, document inventories, workflows, roles, applicable markets, and known audit findings.
